ev.q: a total of 2,784,548 laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 reinfections were reported among adults aged ≥18 years from 18 U.S. jurisdictions
reinfections increased substantially from the Delta (2.7%) to the Omicron BQ.1/BQ.1.1 (28.8%) periods
were consistently higher across variant periods among adults aged 18–49 years compared with those among adults aged ≥50 years

changes.why: Percentages by variant period within age groups are a series over time by group, which the brief counts as comparison, not stratification. Nothing is adjusted, and the report itself says it could not adjust for confounders.

equity.level_reason: Age is the only social-position dimension, used as a stratifier without social-position framing; the age differences are explained by infection history, vaccination and exposure, not social position.

ev.q: Percentages of reinfections among all COVID-19 cases, hospitalizations, and deaths were calculated by age group and variant period.
